coverage: Real AccountActivityController bridge receives same ID from controlled WS/push streams in both orders; in-flight refreshes coalesce and inbox remains one unread item.
Concurrent refresh/loadMore/markRead preserve 21 unique sorted notifications, correct cursor and confirmed read against stale unread response.
Late refresh and loadMore responses cannot cross the clear boundary used on account switch; fresh B inbox remains isolated.
Dispose cancels activity subscriptions and ignores late response/events.
limitations: Controlled WS/push event sources and HTTP mocks; real native Firebase delivery is a separate external prerequisite.
Account-switch test invokes the same clear boundary used by CatStore; actual CatStore account transition is covered separately by RES-03.

First attempt had test fixture type compilation errors; second bound stream subscriptions outside the HTTP mock zone. Both are preserved as harness failures, not product defects. Final run fixes zone and includes source guard.
